# Bid the pad, the delivery, and the extras.

> Price a backyard shed install from pad, delivery miles, crane versus forklift, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $2,499 drop-and-set special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
